summary.intent: Use the GSD manager command center to discuss, plan, and execute three gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) identified in a UAT audit for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 fully complete (8 plans, all waves merged, code review, verification, phase marked done). Phase 43 planning complete and execution through wave 4 of 6 (5/8 plans done including gap-closure plan 43-05). Phase 44 discussed and CONTEXT.md committed; planning and execution not yet started.

repo: Kubo runs with `server` profile + swarm port 4001 publicly exposed in staging (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72): the server profile only disables local-network discovery, so DHT provider records for every pinned CID are broadcast publicly.

The /ipfs/unpin endpoint was protected by JwtAuthGuard only, but signup is open (Web3Auth email/OAuth) — any account holder could unpin any CID by passing a harvested CID string directly to the unguarded handler.
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids (shared-write.ts:450) without calling unpin — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists in the codebase.
Kubo API port 5001 is loopback-only since Phase 29; the HTTP API endpoint is the sole external unpin surface.
BYO IPFS provider unpin path was broken in both directions (client and server advisory rows) before Phase 42.

pnpm double-dash bug: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` fails because pnpm inserts `--` and jest treats the flag as a positional regex. Use `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'` instead.
`.prettierignore` was absent from the repo, causing prettier pre-commit hooks to mangle `.planning/` markdown files and `.claude/` GSD workflow files on every commit.
gsd commit helper returns `committed: false` as a false negative even when the commit actually landed — always verify with `git log`, never blind-retry.
1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true`; signing failures require the user to restart the 1Password app before retrying.

Windows cross-compilation (`cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp`) fails on macOS due to pre-existing issues in `windows-future` and `winfsp-sys` registry crates — unrelated to new changes, verified via `cargo check` as the alternative gate.
cleanup-wave helper resolves the repo root from cwd — running it from inside an agent worktree produces a false `base_mismatch` error; it must be run from the repo root.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged worktree entries report `branch_mismatch` on a rerun. Write a reduced manifest containing only the remaining unmerged entries when retrying.

code.finding: guardedUnpin added: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → transactional row-delete + refcount + pending_unpins insert → Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort. Cross-user attempt emits audit metric rather than 403 to avoid oracle risk.
Upload-compensation path calls guardedUnpin with a D-13 race-window comment explaining why a dedup CID might be shared and why the silent no-op is correct here.

handle_release ordering: journal.put(844) → handle.cleanup(892) → reply.ok(894) → spawn(904) → journal.remove-on-success(943). Journal fsync-before-ack ordering enforced; spawn happens after ack so kernel never waits on the upload.

handle_mkdir: journal.put(534) inside closure before reply.entry(655); conflict arm sends FsEvent::MkdirConflict to re-arm publisher instead of warn-only; journal entry cleared only on parent-publish success.
fetchQuota() reconcile call added after removeUsage() so the local quota store stays consistent with server state even if the optimistic decrement was wrong.
New PendingUnpin entity: columns id (uuid PK), cid (varchar 255), created_at (timestamp). No user_id — the outbox is per-CID, not per-user, matching the shared-dedup semantic.
Alert on rate(cipherbox_unpin_cross_user_attempts_total[5m]) > 0 in new 'CipherBox Security' rule group using existing placeholder-UID provisioning convention.
Drift report is read-only (zero .delete() calls in drift path); calls provider.unpin not raw Kubo, error-isolates per row, and publishes gauge. Drift path is detect-only to avoid auto-GC footgun.

Full rewrite to persist-backed WriteQueue with JournalOp enum (UploadFile|MkdirPublish), JournalEntryStatus, fsync-before-ack, ciphertext-only journal, put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay API.

workflow: GSD worktree merge (worktree.cleanup-wave) must run from the repo root — cwd inside an agent worktree produces false base_mismatch errors.
When cleanup-wave aborts partway due to a non-idempotent run, write a reduced manifest with only the remaining unmerged worktree entries and re-run rather than retrying the full manifest.
Worktree cruft (node_modules, .husky/_) blocks merge; explicitly rm these before running cleanup-wave.
For 1Password signing failures: retry once with dangerouslyDisableSandbox, then ask user to restart 1Password app before a second retry. Never use --no-gpg-sign.
Always verify git commits with `git log` after gsd commit helper returns — the helper has a known false-negative pattern where it reports `committed: false` even on success.
When a merge leaves MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed), conclude it with `git commit --no-edit` rather than aborting.
openapi.json can accumulate formatting-only drift from `nest build` side effects; restore with `git checkout --` before merging to avoid polluting wave diffs.
Decision coverage gates use literal string grep (e.g., `D-07:`) — plan must_haves sections need explicit decision-ID citation lines, not just prose references.
Cross-phase context is made available by rebasing the feature branch onto the completed predecessor branch after each phase closes.
Answer user questions in direct prose first before presenting option menus — presenting menus without answering the underlying question reads as evasion.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures mid-session required user to restart the app; blocked commit pipeline until recovered.
gsd commit helper false negatives caused repeated unnecessary verification steps and wasted retry attempts.
`pnpm test -- --testPathPattern` broken by pnpm double-dash injection; not obvious from error output, required diagnosis.
cleanup-wave not idempotent: a partial run leaving entries in mixed states required writing reduced manifests and re-running.
cleanup-wave cwd bug (false base_mismatch when run from inside a worktree) caused confusing failures before root cause was identified.
Planner agent died mid-plan (socket closed after plans 01-03) requiring filesystem fallback inspection and a continuation planner spawn.
Session context limit hit twice mid-workflow, requiring continuation with summary handoff and breaking assistant flow.
openapi.json formatting drift from `nest build` side effect polluted merge diffs and required manual restore before each wave merge.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failed because the plan had decision prose but not the literal `D-07:` citation token the grep expects.
`.prettierignore` missing from repo caused prettier to mangle `.planning/` docs on every commit; user had to explicitly flag this.
42-05 worktree merge left MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit didn't fire); required manual `git commit --no-edit` and worktree cleanup.
zsh multi-glob `rm -rf` aborts entirely if any glob path misses; requires single explicit paths.
Assistant presented option menus without first answering user's direct questions, causing user frustration and explicit correction.
